label: Dining counter divider

stretch.how: extend the run; one seat per 0.60 m of length

clearance.reason: chair pulled out, plus room to pass behind it
working at the counter from the kitchen side

notes: The divider that doubles as the dining table — one piece of millwork doing the wall's job and the table's job, which is how a compact PH plan gets a dining area without spending a room on it. 0.60 m of base cabinet plus a 0.30 m unsupported OVERHANG, marked by the dashed line across it. That overhang is the whole difference from counter_peninsula: without knee room you are perching at a snack bar, not sitting at a table. 0.38 m is more comfortable if the plan can spare it. Seats go on the living side only — the kitchen side stays working counter.
